## Codex (credits per 1M tokens)

+----------------------------+------------+------------+------------+--------------+--------------+--------------+

## Claude Code (USD per 1M tokens)

+----------------------------+------------+------------+------------+--------------+--------------+--------------+
| Model (`/model`)[^claude]  | Input      | Cache hit  | Output     | Burn: in     | Burn: cached | Burn: out    |
+============================+============+============+============+==============+==============+==============+
| Haiku 5.5 (`haiku`)        | $0.10      | $0.01      | $0.50      | 1×           | 1×           | 1×           |
+----------------------------+------------+------------+------------+--------------+--------------+--------------+
| Sonnet 5.5 (`sonnet`)      | $2         | $0.10      | $10        | 20×          | 10×          | 20×          |
+----------------------------+------------+------------+------------+--------------+--------------+--------------+
| Opus 5.5 (`opus`, default) | $4         | $0.20      | $20        | 40×          | 20×          | 40×          |
+----------------------------+------------+------------+------------+--------------+--------------+--------------+
| Opus 5.5 fast (`/fast`)    | $8         | $0.40      | $40        | 80×          | 40×          | 80×          |
+----------------------------+------------+------------+------------+--------------+--------------+--------------+
| Fable 5.1 (`fable`)        | $10        | $0.25      | $50        | 100×         | 25×          | 100×         |
+----------------------------+------------+------------+------------+--------------+--------------+--------------+

Checked 2026-10-23:
[OpenAI pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing),
[Codex models](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models),
[Anthropic pricing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing),
[Claude Code models](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config).

[^codex]: Credits = 25 × the OpenAI API USD rate; Codex does not charge for cache writes. Fast mode: 2× the standard rate. GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra/Sol remain available during the GPT-6 rollout. API long context (>272K input): 2× input and cached, 1.5× output.
[^claude]: Anthropic API rates; Pro/Max/Team plans draw from plan usage limits instead. Cache writes: 1.25× input (5m), 2× input (1h). Haiku 5.5 prompts >100K tokens: 5× all rates. `opusplan`: Opus in plan mode, Sonnet for execution.
